frictions.description: Live external/page dependency (youtube_live_dep) detected in 5+ file(s).
frictions.solution_plan: Served by the same replica host-resolver; the recorded playlist/token bytes live under G:/Temp/ko-replica and the scenario is dev-fast. Replay cost is the same 8-11.5 s measurement above.
frictions.notes: The same offline page/playlist/token shape is served locally, so a YouTube-side check does not wait for a live broadcast; the twin records the playlist bytes once.

frictions.description: Live external/page dependency (browser_live_wait) detected in 5+ file(s).
frictions.solution_plan: Warm-guest mode (--prepare-guest / --attach-guest) with a private KO_MARKER outside G:/Temp/ko-harness so no other lane's stop sweep can kill it; startup measured 155-674 ms across the three runs. Teardown must kill the TREE (taskkill /T): 77 leaked replica chrome processes were measured and cleaned before this.
frictions.notes: A guest Chrome is pre-warmed once (--prepare-guest) and runs attach (--attach-guest), so a measurement is 8.0-11.5 s instead of a cold navigate plus content-script wait (measured 14.4 s).

frictions.description: Live external/page dependency (twitch_live_dep) detected in 5+ file(s).
frictions.solution_plan: Measured 3 identical PASS runs on 8444: 8 062 ms / 11 503 ms / 8 942 ms, `RESULT PASS scenario=dev-fast checks=11 failed=0 cannot=0`. The twin asserts a real pixel flip (blue 0.136-0.139), overlay-reveal, ad-ui-release and native-handoff, so it fails without the product; the --no-ext control arm is the remaining proof (its run returned CANNOT-MEASURE under load, recorded as owed).
frictions.notes: A whole cold-preroll pod (ad -> overlay-reveal -> ad-end -> native hand-back) replays from a local HTTPS replica instead of waiting for a real Twitch ad.

frictions.description: Primary edit -> test -> verify inner loop must run incrementally/cached in <= 15s with zero owner dependency.
frictions.solution_plan: Virtual clock landed 2026-11-26 (kick-overlay/_clock.cjs): the two behavioural suites advance an injected clock instead of sleeping, so the real edit->test loop is 887 ms + 4 724 ms with identical check counts (95 and 185). KO_REAL_CLOCK=1 replays the old real-timer path.
